_comment: Teamwork Graph persisted Cypher queries. Registered once per app by scripts/register-twg-queries.mjs; keys land in queryKeys.json. Queries are immutable: to change one, edit the text here and re-run the script, which returns a new key.

queries.name: precedent-issue-goals
queries.purpose: Goals the current work item contributes to (conflict card: 'tied to goal G')

queries.name: precedent-goal-teams
queries.purpose: Teams contributing to a goal (conflict card: 'and team T')

queries.name: precedent-issue-linked-issues
queries.purpose: Work items linked to a decision's source issue (related work)

queries.name: precedent-page-contributors
queries.purpose: People who contributed to a decision's source page ('who to ask')

queries.name: precedent-user-teams
queries.purpose: Teams a decision owner belongs to (agent: 'who should I talk to')
